m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Aha! You look splendid! Very well. Now, I will go in and begin my performance. You wait a moment and then come in behind me.
While I am dancing, everyone will be distracted. Make your way up to the Empress's private balcony and swipe the key from her pillow.
Brilliant, isn't it? I told you. It's flawless. What could possibly go wrong? All right. It's show-time! I'll see you inside!
What's this? A new dancer? You're late. Not the way to make a good first impression.
Well, what's the problem? Get in there. Don't keep the Empress waiting.
<ITALICS> The Theater is richly decorated, red velvet curtains trimmed with Tundarian gold. Very fancy. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS> Bearyshnakov is center stage, putting on an impressive performance. Even the guards are mesmerized. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS> In the balcony above, you can see Empress Antuskutte, enraptured by Bearyshnakov's bold routine. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You gently pull the key out from under the Empress's pillow, but somehow, the movement catches her attention. </ITALICS>
Bravo, my little Bearyshnakov. Bravo!
Oh... but who is this? A new dancer? Oh, how exciting! I think I want to see you dance! Oh, yes, I do!
Go on down to the stage, darling. Oh, this will be such a treat!
Perhaps my plan wasn't as perfect as I thought. I don't see any way to avoid this though.
Just... go up there and do your best. How bad could it be?
<ITALICS>At first, you feel clumsy and awkward, but after a moment, the music seems to take over, directing your movements. </ITALICS>
How very... modern? I don't think I've ever seen anyone dance like that.
Yes. Uh, it's called the... the Crazy Clown. It's very fashionable in Marleybone. We are lucky to have someone with such... talent.
Oh, well, if it's fashionable in Marleybone... we should see more of it. Haha! Very good. Yes. Bravo. Uh, you can stop now.
You're... too kind, Your Huge-I mean Your Highness. We both thank you. We should go practice now.
Psst. Meet me back in the dressing room. Quickly.
Well, that didn't go exactly as planned, did it? Haha. It could've been worse, though.
Bearyshnakov, soon as you're dressed, the Empress wants a word. Bring that new dancer, too.
Or maybe not. You have the key, right? I think it's time for us to make our departures.
Take the key back to your friends quickly, and I wish you the best of luck storming the Basstille.
Thank you, my friend, for securing my escape. I hope we meet again someday.
Ah, there you are! I was worried. I heard there was some kind of scandal at the Bolshoi Theater.
I have devised what I think is a rather ingenious plan to steal the Basstille Key. You will take it while she is engrossed by my dancing.
The Empress waits in the Theater even now. I'll go in and begin my performance. You come in behind me, posing as one of the new dancers.
I have an Enchanted Tutu here that I use for emergencies, so someone might stand in when a dancer is injured.
Once you put it on, you'll look just like one of us. Go on. The dressing rack is right there.
Don't be shy now. No one will ever know the difference. Put on the Enchanted Tutu so the Empress will think you are one of the new dancers.
